description: Current weather, hourly (48h) and daily (9-day) forecast for any city name, US ZIP code or lat/lon worldwide, plus active US NWS alerts. Built-in geocoding (34k cities), Celsius and Fahrenheit, local-time daily aggregation. Data: MET Norway. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.002: /api/weather)

lat.description: Latitude -90..90 (use with lon instead of q)

q.description: City name, optionally with region and/or country: 'Paris', 'Paris, FR', 'Springfield, IL, US'. Use q OR lat+lon.

zip.description: US ZIP code (alternative to q), e.g. 10001
